overview: This Senate resolution supports naming the week of April 21 through April 25, 2025, "National Home Visiting Week." Home visiting programs send trained workers, such as nurses or social workers, to meet regularly with parents of young children at home to support healthy development and reduce the risk of abuse and neglect. The resolution notes that these programs operate in all 50 states and highlights the reach of the federal Maternal, Infant, and Early Childhood Home Visiting Program. It expresses support for the goals of the week but does not create programs or provide money. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on April 29, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution recognizes programs that give parents practical help and give young children a stronger start in life.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or funding for home visiting programs.
